# NAACP Legal Defense Fund

> > The NAACP Legal Defense and Educational Fund (LDF) is America's premier civil rights law organization, fighting for racial justice through litigation, advocacy, and public education.

Founded in 1940 under Thurgood Marshall's leadership, LDF continues the fight for racial justice through landmark cases in voting rights, education equity, criminal justice reform, and economic justice. LDF's work includes defending the Voting Rights Act, challenging discriminatory redistricting, advocating against qualified immunity, and protecting affirmative action in higher education.

## Key Topics

- Voting Rights Act
- Shelby County v. Holder
- Redistricting and representation
- Affirmative action in higher education
- Qualified immunity and police accountability
- Fair housing and discrimination
- Educational equity
- Supreme Court litigation
- Thurgood Marshall legacy
- Preclearance requirements
- Civil rights advocacy
- Criminal justice reform
- Racial justice
- Amicus briefs

## About LDF

- [About Us](https://www.naacpldf.org/about-us): LDF's mission fighting for racial justice through litigation & advocacy

## Voting Rights & Redistricting

- [Allen v. Milligan (Formerly Merrill v. Milligan)](https://www.naacpldf.org/case-issue/alabama-redistricting-case): Alabama congressional map redistricting Supreme Court VRA victory
- [Chisom v. State of Louisiana: Ensuring Access to Equal Representation in the Judicial Branch](https://www.naacpldf.org/case-issue/chisom-v-state-of-louisiana): Louisiana Supreme Court judicial election voting rights case
- [Shelby First Anniversary Countdown: Day 19](https://www.naacpldf.org/shelby-first-anniversary-countdown/shelby-first-anniversary-countdown-day-19): Ernest Montgomery case in Calera, Alabama after Shelby County decision
- [Shelby First Anniversary Countdown: Day 15](https://www.naacpldf.org/shelby-first-anniversary-countdown/shelby-first-anniversary-countdown-day-15): Baker County polling place closures after Shelby County VRA ruling
- [Shelby First Anniversary Countdown: Day 22](https://www.naacpldf.org/shelby-first-anniversary-countdown-day-22): Voting Rights Amendment Act response to Shelby County decision

## Education & Affirmative Action

- [SFFA v. Harvard and SFFA v. UNC FAQ](https://www.naacpldf.org/case-issue/sffa-v-harvard-faq): FAQ on Supreme Court affirmative action decisions at Harvard & UNC
- [South Carolina for Truth in Education](https://www.naacpldf.org/truth-2/south-carolina-protruth): South Carolina campaign for inclusive education & opposing H.3728
- [Schools Reopening Guide](https://www.naacpldf.org/ldf-mission/education/schools-reopening-guide): COVID-19 school reopening guide promoting student health & equity
- [One Nation, Indivisible](https://www.naacpldf.org/news/one-nation-indivisible): University of Texas affirmative action & diversity in admissions

## Criminal Justice & Police Accountability

- [Qualified Immunity: Common Myths Debunked](https://www.naacpldf.org/qualified-immunity-myths-and-dangers): Debunking myths about qualified immunity & police accountability

## Housing & Economic Justice

- [Magner v. Gallagher](https://www.naacpldf.org/case-issue/magner-v-gallagher): Supreme Court amicus brief on fair housing disparate impact test
- [Dorce v. City of New York](https://www.naacpldf.org/case-issue/mcconnell-dorce-v-city-of-new-york): NYC third-party transfer program housing discrimination amicus brief
